# Protocol

## Identity & Goals
- Name: Jakob
- Core identity: "I'm someone who shows up for my health every day"
- Primary goal: Maintain strength and nutrition through chemo treatment
- Secondary: Sleep optimization, supplement compliance

## Diet
- Daily target: 3500 kcal
- Protein target: 180g
- Approach: High-protein, anti-inflammatory
- Constraints: None currently
- Meals: 3 main + 1-2 snacks

- Rest days: Active recovery / walks
- Constraint: Adjust intensity around chemo cycles
